judgments.justification: Base amounts total 5415 and numbers run 042-044 with the idle client skipped. The ledger stays at 041/uninvoiced. Due dates violate client terms, contact details are missing or placeholders, and zero tax/USD are unsupported assumptions. Each HTML has paper margins and print CSS, but spacing and styling vary; no rendered print check.
